title: Upcoming breaking change: array_contains with a constant empty array will return NULL for a NULL value
body:
Starting on or after January 15, 2027, with ANSI mode enabled in Databricks Runtime 19 and above, `array_contains(arr, value)` will return NULL, not false, when `arr` is a constant empty array and `value` is NULL. `map_contains_key(map, key)` with a constant empty map will change the same way. As a result, `NOT array_contains(arr, value)` will no longer match rows where `value` is NULL.

To keep the previous result, use `size(arr) > 0 AND array_contains(arr, value)`.

See [`array_contains` function](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/array_contains) and [`map_contains_key` function](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/map_contains_key).
